The show takes a satirical look at the week in news, politics and current events.[1] As of April 26, 2026,[update] 359 episodes of Last Week Tonight with John Oliver have aired.[2] The show's twelfth season premiered on February 16, 2025 with the finale airing on November 16 of the same year.
